description: February 6 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 2, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 6 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the second decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: The February 6 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: A humane Aquarian tone runs through February 6. The 6 is traditionally the number of responsibility and care for others, and here it sits about seventeen degrees into Uranus's sign, in the decan Mercury sub-rules. That suggests someone who looks after people by sharing information, teaching skills and making sure everybody in the group feels heard.

Astronomically, February 6 puts the Sun near 17° Aquarius in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aquarius the sub-ruler is Mercury, the ruler of Gemini. Birthdays from around January 30 to February 8 tend to bring a quick, communicative intelligence to the sign's idealism. Natives are often seen as witty, curious and well networked, the kind of person who knows someone in every group and enjoys connecting them. Writing, teaching and technical problem-solving are commonly associated with this decan. Mercury can make the mind race ahead of the body and the heart. Slowing down long enough to listen as well as explain usually deepens their many connections.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for February 6
paragraphs: A birthday on the 6th produces a birthday number of 6, unreduced. As the secondary number in a chart, the day of birth hints at how someone naturally contributes to the people around them. The 6 is the number of the household in Pythagorean tradition: care, responsibility, beauty in the home and fairness within the family. Those born on the 6th are often the friend who remembers birthdays and notices when someone is struggling. Their usual lesson is that looking after others works best when they include themselves in the circle of care too.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a February 6 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous February 6 birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 6 is the 37th day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Pisces, is usually complete within 13 days, by February 19.

Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by February 6 in 69 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it. Among the best-known people with a February 6 birthday are Ronald Reagan (1911), Bob Marley (1945) and François Truffaut (1932).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 6?
faq.answer: February 6 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 6?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 6 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 6th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 6?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, February 6 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 69 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 6?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on February 6 include Ronald Reagan (1911), Bob Marley (1945) and François Truffaut (1932). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
